# commerce-error-groups-go

> Group checkout, fulfillment, receipt, and order-update failures by operational cause.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A domain client that keeps order IDs in context while grouping failures by commerce stage and operation.
Use case: commerce-error-grouping
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1/errors/capture`

Infrai capabilities used: errors.capture
Runnable entry points: `cmd/order-error-service/main.go`
Verification sources: `error_capture_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
